reviews.comment: Dr. Gillett was an unprofessional professor who reveled in attempting to leverage power over students to the point of requiring further faculty involvement. She has regularly and erroneously sent a third of her students to the honors council each semester. Dr. Gillett is exactly the person you do not want teaching students of professionalism.

Worst professor I have had so far. She is snide and condescending, and on a massive power-trip. She will try to find any reason to accuse you of plagarism and don't even try to ask her a question via email.  I wouldn't take this class again if you paid me to. Also, she is married to the head of the department, which says more than any review can.

This class wasn't hard, just do your work and do it EARLY. She likes when students turn in work EARLY. There were no exams, attendance, or class. Just discussion boards, papers, quizzes, and a group project. You do have to actually put in the work on the papers in this class. Try and you will do great! :)

ALSO... do not use AI

One of the best classes I have ever had. This course is required for ALL Forensic and Entomology students. No exams, just discussion posts and assignments. Everything is at your own pace and can be finished on your own time. Prof. Gillett-Kaufman is an amazing professor and provided amazing insight when it came to doing the assignments. Great class

Lots of work, but totally fair for an online class. She replies faster than my group chat and gives tons of chances to earn points—extra credit too! Easy A if you stay ahead. Her feedback was great and much appreciated for the writing submissions.

Okay this class was actually so easy it just requires more writing. Honestly the assigments are so easy and if you follow the rubric then you'll be fine. I would take it if you need a more chill class. She also gives you feedback so you can always see what she is exactly looking for.

She is incredibly unhelpful when you reach out for clarification on a grade or the wording of assignments.She will take off an excessive amount of points for MINOR mistakes. Should be an easy A but many people struggle because of the ridiculous grading. Also is known to Honor Code (usually unjustly) a good chunk of students in class. Good luck 🫡
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Yall….. this is the fourth week of class and I already regret taking this class. I have gotten points taken off for the SILLIEST things like I just can't belive my eyes. Oh and let me tell you, she takes off a LOT of points for MINOR mistakes. The average for the first discussion post is a 69. A DISCUSSION POST. Let that speak for itself.

I'm sorry to all fivs/ento people who have to take this. Very important information to learn, but she is the least understanding prof to ever exist. I'm convinced she's on a power trip. Not at all understanding, even when a student makes their first mistake in the last month of classes. Read the other posts to see that I'm not the only one.
Pretty easy A and you're done in early-mid November. Lots of discussion posts and other writing assignments, but nothing impossible.

This course was needed for the FIVS program, and she's the only professor available. She was very unprofessional and made the material more difficult than needed. For the first half of the semester, she would make backhanded comments on her students' work, but they gradually improved. Her class is doable, but expect a high time commitment.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This teacher will do everything she can to make your life more difficult. Absolutely 0 understanding given to students. IF YOU ARE DISABLED-DO NOT TAKE. NOT ACCOMODATING AT ALL. She will do anything she can to weasel her way out of accommodations. The spirit of the law does not exist. She will make you jump through hoops to get help in her class.

I've had Dr. Gillett for a couple of classes. She's not bad like many of the other individuals have suggested. I legit made over a 98.5 in both of her classes. Just don't cheat and read her instructions and you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor is extremely rude and prides herself on making her students cry. She made some mildly racist remarks and always speaks in a condescending manner, often speaking to other students about "problematic" students aloud in her office before meeting them. She did not create an environment conducive to my academic and professional success.

Assignments were waaay too long. She also takes points off for things that are subjective. There would usually be a written assignment every week but one week the assignment was to go to a career fair and they were all over by the time I got to that assignment so I couldn't turn anything in and it dropped my grade several points which was annoying.

Lots of busy work but overall found the information interesting and well organized. Lots of writing and researching, which I didn't mind. She is a tough grader, so make sure to follow all of her instructions. Easy A just requires a bit of effort.

This class was an easy A, however dont let that persuade you to take this professor. She is looking for any reason to send you to the honor council or accuse you of plagiarism. She is extremely condescending and straight up disrespectful in her emails, with any attempt to combat her being met with intimidation, bullying, and unprofessionalism.

The class is easy, but the professor makes the class unenjoyable. Her responses to questions are rude and condescending. She is a really tough grader even though some of her instructions are vague. It was a lot of busy work. Just do all the assignments and you should be ok.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Legit was dumbfounded by half of the emails she responded with. Extremley rude and does not care about you at all. Be prepared for your grade to tank if you make 1 simple mistake on an assignment, and she will laugh in your face if you try and ask for anything you can do about it.

Do not take this professor. She expects everything to be turned in over a week early and her expectations are very unclear for the assignments. She is very strict about little things and grades harshly. It is an easy A, but can be a pain because of how particular she is.

Do not take ENTO482 (professional development) with this professor. She does not grade easily. She is not lenient whatsoever, and when emailed with questions about the assignments she practically refuses to answer questions. She responds very rudely as well. Just not a nice teacher and probably forgot what it was like to be a student.

Although the class started out rough when she accused a lot of students of using AI on a paper, when they did not, this class is easy to get an A in. If you take it seriously, it will help you out TREMENDOUSLY in your professional career. She taught me so much about the professional field, that I would have never learned outside of this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR! She is a bully and would rather have 10 innocent men locked up than 1 guilty man roam free. She tried to fail a dozen students claiming that they had used AI to write a paper, and when the students tried to contest her decision she was extremely unprofessional and tried to intimidate the students into backing down.

ENTO 322 was a very easy class and only required a bit of effort every week to complete assignments. Most of the assignments were just a discussion post or writing a brief paper. A fair warning however, she is very trigger happy when it comes to academic dishonesty. One of my friends was suspected of plagiarism and received a 0 when he was innocent

The professor is extremely self-important and lazy. Most of the course materials were pre-compiled by her former graduate students, so all she actually does is grading. It's very obvious that entomology is just her hobby that she turned into a full-time job, but she demands that you respect it and give her respect because she's a professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Gillett is pretty straight forward on what she wants. A lot of reviews are saying she is looking for a reason to fail you but if you just read the assignment description and follow everything she asks of you, it is pretty hard to fail. Offers extra credit, no exams, weekly work is the same. I would take if you need a science credit!

This professor is looking for reasons to report students to honor council. She will respond to emails with nonanswers. if you ask for clarification, she will tell you to read the discussion board Q and A and post it there if the question hasn't been asked. she does not help students. While the class itself is not hard, she makes it miserable.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. if no other review sways you please listen to this one. she wants a reason to fail you and report you and trust, she will find any and every reason to give you a zero. she is also a due date bully. DO NOT TAKE HER!!!!

This was a super easy online class, and I was able to do lots of my work ahead of time and finish the course early. For the discussion questions, you don't even have to watch all the videos - just pick and chose the ones you need. There are several essays and a debate video that takes more effort, but just stay on top of deadlines and you'll be ok.

Pretty solid prof. Lots of busy work, but it's manageable. The group/partner project is a pain, can't lie. Beyond that it's fine. A lot of completion credit. Was very adamant that she doesn't round grades AT ALL but she ended up taking me from a B to an A at the very end. All in all, good prof and manageable class. Not a total blowoff, but close.

Dr. Gillett-Kaufman is officially one of my favorite professors. She is so kind and caring, and her course is pretty interesting. There are quite a few assignments due each week. However, they are not difficult, and no exams! The lecture videos were entertaining, and I learned a lot of cool things about insects. Highly recommend her!

As a liberal arts major, this course was great for fulfilling my core science credit. While there are several assignments due each week, they are all relatively straightforward to complete. Simply following the instructions will result in an A. Another perk to this course is that there are no exams. It can almost be considered writing-intensive.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Super nice teacher and extremely easy class. Lots of homework, which is very easy but kind of annoying, and one group project with a random partner, which isn't fun at all. Very clear grading criteria and hard to score badly on assignments. Easy A if you do the work.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: So much busywork that this class actually took away from my other classes. The prof is hot or cold. Don't address her as anything other than Dr. in emails, she lost her mind on a few others in the course. Hopefully you get a cool TA that does your grading. She is tough. No exams, just a good amount of stuff you have to do weekly.

This class was a lot lol. Lots and lots of assignments, everything is doable but just a lot. You have to do a couple big assignments that are time consuming so be ware of that. The TAs grade most things and are easy but when Dr. Kaufman grades it can be a little tough.

This class is somewhat of a blow off class but there is multiple items due each week. I think the one thing that bothered me was she expects you to have the assignment submitted 48 hours before the due date and if its not she takes points off which I personally dont agree with. The work was easy and she gives good feedback just manage your time.

Super easy-A & blowoff class. Only a discussion once a week and a few math quizzes (extremely simple arithmetic). The most annoying part was the project - you debate with a randomly assigned parter within the class. If you get a decent partner like I did, you're set, but if you don't maybe contact the prof, she's pretty cool. Take this teach!

Really simple class and easy to receive an A in. This prof wants you to really learn something actually a huge part of your grade is talking about what you thought was the most interesting part of a certain section. I really did come away with an understanding of bugs I never thought that I would. Great class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: One of the best classes and professors I've taken. If you do the 1-2 assignments that are assigned each week you can get an A in the class there are no exams just a couple small projects nothing difficult. If you get a low assignment grade which is rare she lets you redo it for a better grade, very understanding and caring. 100% recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: The whole class is online. Super light courseload, sometimes I forgot I was enrolled in this class lol. If you need a science requirement take this blow-off class right here. No exams just basic math quizzes and vibes

EASY A. The class is based on points, once you reach 900, which is an A you do not need to do any more work. Do not copy anything you find on the internet, she doesn't like you citing other people's work, and she has actually sent people to the honor council for it. For the three writing assignments, she grades hard everything else she grades easy

I loved Dr. Jennifer Gillett, She made sure to read and reply to everything you submitted. She truly cares about her students and enjoys giving feedback on your assignments. The only down fall is you have to wait for people to post disscusions to reply to and you have a partner project. TAKE THIS CLASS you wont regret it!

She doesn't really do anything. The class is really taught by two other Grad Students from years before. She also takes her job way to seriously. She wont respond to emails and when she does she is just plain rude.

Super easy class, all you have to do is reach a certain amount of points and you get an A (after that, you are done with the class). She sets this class up this way so as to make sure you are not overwhelmed. She is a very lenient grader. If you need a science class, take this class with her. Just make sure to stay on top of the hw to finish early.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT
